shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo ---; ls /workspace/node_modules | head -50; echo ---; ls /workspace/__agent_eval__; echo ---; git -C /workspace log --stat -p -1
rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install 2>&1 | tail -30

curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o '

.*

\|Nothing here yet\|Nothing finished yet'

curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o 'Project Hail Mary\|Andy Weir\|Currently reading ([0-9]*)\|Finished ([0-9]*)\|Mark finished' echo "---detail page---" BOOK_ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8'))[0].id)") curl -s http://localhost:3100/books/$BOOK_ID | grep -o '

.*

\|by Andy Weir\|Great pacing so far\.\|Currently reading\|Mark as finished' echo "BOOK_ID=$BOOK_ID"

curl -s -o /dev/null -w "detail page status: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/books/8a228df8-f22c-426f-a028-292a98e8b28f
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "unknown book status: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/books/does-not-exist
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null
rm -f data/books.json
sleep 1
echo done
